method: Baseline and rebuilt examples aligned by character spans in the same physical DOCX unit, then reviewed with italic/roman runs. Offsets are NFC characters including whitespace. Source irregularities are retained verbatim, without inferred wording or renumbering.

classes.source-untranslated: The DOCX supplies a form or Turoyo sentence/passage, with no complete source translation for it.
classes.source-editorial-or-metadata: An editorial remark, source caption, author/chat metadata or heading, with no Turoyo/translation pair. Retained verbatim.
classes.source-partial-or-irregular-gloss: A fragmentary gloss, gloss-only row, Russian/English working annotation, or grammatical aside that does not supply a separable complete translation. Retained verbatim.
classes.parser-unquoted-translation: Complete unquoted translation recovered from formatting or explicit English syntax, including absent/inverted formatting and parentheses.
classes.parser-translation-in-following-paragrap: Turoyo passage reunited with its complete translation in a later paragraph.
classes.parser-quoted-translation-fragment: A translation or its closing mark had been split at nested quotes, a possessive apostrophe, or a paragraph/run boundary. Reattached.
classes.parser-citation-or-label-fragment: A citation, speaker mark or source label had been emitted as a separate example. Reattached.
classes.parser-citation-fragment: A citation-only artificial example inherited an otherwise unmatched sense. The fragment is now part of the preceding example.
classes.parser-timestamp-or-comment-number: A timestamp minute, source locator, or number in a quotation/comment was read as a sense marker. No inferred replacement number is introduced.
classes.parser-implicit-first-gloss: An unnumbered first gloss preceding an explicit 2) was folded into sense 2. It is now sense 1, retaining the raw source.
classes.source-absent-detransitive-list: The DOCX explicitly numbers examples in a Detransitive section but supplies no separate Detransitive sense list. Ordinary senses are not copied.
classes.source-absent-stem-list: The source numbers an ordinary example but supplies no ordinary sense list for this stem.
classes.source-number-not-in-list: The example number is literal in the source and absent from the supplied stem/diathesis list. Kept unchanged.
classes.source-box-local-numbering: A numbered Action Noun gloss list is local to that source section, while IEntry stores senses at stem/diathesis level. The explicit box heading and local glosses are preserved; numbering is not rewritten.
classes.parser-fused-examples: The baseline Turoyo field contained an embedded translation followed by a citation, matching the parent diagnostic regex. Corrected example boundaries are recorded in after.
